instruction: Build one valid CLOSED solid cushion_body on Cushion::Upholstery::Body, all visible and unlocked. No extra objects or new layers beyond those three; preserve existing empty layers. At scale S the footprint is x,y=0..100*S, flat underside z=0, vertical planar walls on the four footprint edges, and one continuous smooth untrimmed top z=S*(10+20*f(x/(100*S))*f(y/(100*S)))), where f(t)=432*t*t*(t-0.5)*(t-0.5)*(t-1)*(t-1). Four lobes and crossing seams. Height-field tolerance is S mm. Minimum vertical thickness is 10*S mm at seams and perimeter. Top must have continuous first derivatives internally; sharp C0 joins to vertical sides and underside are intentional for this bounded task. Build using existing surface tools and join_surfaces; the latter is a restricted recipe through the existing run_command tool, not a new production command. Native Join requires coincident edges and may replace IDs. Inspect get_objects afterward and assign final name and full layer path. Read command schemas. No shell, arbitrary scripts or file access. Supervisor saves, evaluates and captures independently.
